verdict.rationale: Privacy posture around AI training is a fair question for a SaaS feature-flag platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documented AI-training opt-out, no no-training policy, and no data-usage commitment about model training. Self-hosting, Edge keeping targeting PII local, and external metrics staying in your system are adjacent data-locality features, not a control that prevents data from being used to train AI models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
